svg.text: Domino 6.3 Deployment Pipeline, Operator Drift Reconciliation, Keycloak SSO & Day-2 Lifecycle
Horizontal Layered View: Phase 1 Terraform IaC -> Phase 2 Platform Operator (ddlctl v0.6.4) -> Keycloak & UAT -> Day-2 Upgrades & Nexus
LAYER 1 — PHASE 1: TERRAFORM GCP INFRASTRUCTURE PROVISIONING & AUTO-RENDERED DOMINO.YML (scripts/01 & 02)
• Installs ddlctl v0.6.4 & checks Docker socket
• Verifies your-gcp-project-id N2 CPU & VPC Quotas
• Creates KMS Key, VPC, GKE 1.35 & 3 Node Pools
• Creates Filestore (1TB), CMEK GCS & GAR Repo
• Populates Filestore IP, GCS Bucket, GAR & SAs
LAYER 2 — PHASE 2: DOMINO PLATFORM OPERATOR BOOTSTRAP, DOMINO CRD & DRIFT RECONCILIATION (scripts/03)
• Offline Option: ddlctl images + skopeo copy
LAYER 3 — KEYCLOAK IDENTITY ONBOARDING (DOMINOREALM), SSO FEDERATION & USER ACCEPTANCE TESTING (UAT)
• Option 1 (Self-Signup): Enable 'User Registration' under Realm Settings -> Login, register first user, then disable
• Option 2 (Admin Provisioned): Manage -> Users -> Add User -> Credentials -> Role Mappings -> Client Roles: domino-play -> User
• Configure Realm Settings -> Email (SMTP) & Identity Providers (OIDC / SAML 2.0 / LDAP Federation)
• Promote Admin in Domino UI: Admin -> Advanced -> Users
3B. Comprehensive User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Verification Suite
• Admin & Control Center: Verify active Platform & Compute nodes, Central Config, and Executions view
• Compute Environments: Build custom environment via Hephaestus & verify image push to Google Artifact Registry
• Workspaces & Jobs: Launch JupyterLab, RStudio, VSCode; run batch Python/R jobs; verify DFS & Git sync
• Datasets, Apps & Clusters: Test ReadWriteMany Dataset snapshots, Flask/Shiny Apps, Model APIs & Ray/Dask/Spark
LAYER 4 — DAY-2 OPERATIONS: GKE KUBERNETES UPGRADE, DOMINO UPGRADE & NEXUS REMOTE DATA PLANES (scripts/04)
1. Backup & delete MongoDB PDBs in domino-platform:
3. Upgrade platform, compute, gpu Node Pools
1. Run Domino Admin Toolkit cluster health checks
2. Check drift: ddlctl get helmrelease -A --status stalled=true
• Connects to Control Plane LBs: RabbitMQ (5672/5552),
